vetSays.line: A person, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Thirst doesn't negotiate. Going." The pantry won't fill itself.
💧 A person, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +4 clean.
A person, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek will work the garden once each day while at Haven. Other orders take priority.
🌱 A person, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek looks over the garden: turned soil, nothing planted. Someone has to sow first.
📓 Journal: the person in their 50s, with a scarred cheek taught the woman in her 40s, with a wiry build Steady Hands.
A person, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
A person, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek shakes their head. "Ask someone who trusts you." (Trust too low.)
A person, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)

🌿 A person, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek checks the pantry before heading out — the shelves are full, ~4 days of fresh on hand… leaves the harvest standing and turns to the wood run instead. The pantry can't take more; the wild will keep.
🪵 A person, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek hauls back 6 wood. The pile grows. (16 logs now.)
You catch fragments by the fire — A person, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek telling A person, maybe 60s, with a long braid about you. The story's getting bigger than what happened.
A person, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Fetching water. Somebody has to." The pantry won't fill itself.
📋 A person, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
🛡️ Camila, Otto and Amy met them at the door — 3 put down. Otto, Amy are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Sanne just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
🛡️ Camila, Otto, Amy, Sanne and Ingrid met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Otto, Amy, Ingrid are hurt.

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
⚠ This one is different — old, patient, unhurried — it has seen your kind before. An Elder veteran.
